subject.title: [Bug] OpenClaw UI WebSocket reconnect 导致会话 terminated

question: Should OpenClaw repair or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/41067 as the canonical active-run reconnect fix, or should this issue get a narrower current-main implementation instead?
rationale: Current main has partial mitigations, while the remaining fix crosses Gateway session state, Control UI busy state, and reconnect UX; the open PR is also conflicting and proof-gated, so automation should not choose the permanent contract alone.

options.title: Repair or replace the recovery PR
options.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical design source, but require a rebase or narrow replacement plus real Control UI reconnect proof before merge.

options.title: Implement a narrower main fix
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a smaller patch that consumes the existing server active-run state without taking the broader restart-notice changes.

options.title: Close as mitigated
options.body: Accept the current queued-send/session-row mitigations and leave the active-run adoption gap unresolved.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the recovery PR
recommendation.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical design source, but require a rebase or narrow replacement plus real Control UI reconnect proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision spans Gateway session ownership and Control UI behavior, and recent gateway lifecycle history points to this owner as the best routing candidate among the observed history.
